resources.string: Share glucose, meals, exercise, sleep and cycle with other apps
Health Connect is where Android health apps store and share data. Everything here stays on the phone; none of it goes through GluSync. Each data type is turned on separately.
Health Connect isn\'t installed on this phone (on Android 13 or earlier it\'s a separate app).
Health Connect still needs to allow what you turned on below.
So your other health apps can see it.
Sensor readings (as a continuous sensor) and diary finger sticks. Sent in batches, about every 30 minutes.
Carbs and calories from diary meals. Health Connect has no insulin type, so insulin never leaves GluView.
For patterns and the diary. With the app closed, it only reads if Health Connect allows background reading.
Goes into the diary marked as coming from Health Connect and feeds the patterns.
To compare night-time glucose with sleep duration.
Periods and flow, to compare glucose by cycle phase.
Show up in the diary as suggestions; they only go in if you tap Add.
Shown as grey dots on the chart. Never triggers alerts (it may arrive late).
On the first exchange it writes and reads this period. After that, only what\'s new.
See and delete data and change permissions
Deletes from GluView the data read from Health Connect (sleep, cycle, exercise and glucose from other apps). Nothing is deleted in Health Connect. Exercises already added to the diary stay there.
They came through Health Connect. They only go into the diary if you add them.
If you turn it on, GluView writes to Health Connect: your glucose sensor readings, finger sticks and diary meals (carbs and calories).
If you turn it on, GluView reads from Health Connect: exercise, sleep, menstrual cycle, meals, glucose, steps and active calories recorded by other apps.
Data read stays only on your phone and is used to show patterns and the diary. It isn\'t sent to GluSync or anyone else.
Patterns are only observations of what already happened. GluView doesn\'t recommend doses or treatment.
You can turn each type off in Settings › Health Connect and revoke the permissions in Health Connect itself at any time.

Observations of what already happened, from the sensor and Health Connect. They aren\'t dose or treatment advice: talk to your care team.
